purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 814 Changwon (city code 3320); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Changwon Special City; district 민원지적과 offices
registryBasis: Changwon City official notices describe an electronic cadastral-drawing information kiosk at district offices, allowing people to browse cadastral information for the integrated Changwon city land area. This is local public cadastral access, but the notice describes an on-site touchscreen service rather than an anonymous web vector API.

officialSources.observation: Official Seongsan District notice says its public electronic-drawing kiosk provides no-fee browsing of cadastral information for all integrated Changwon land, plus land-use/value layers. The notice dates from 2010 and describes a physical kiosk.
Official Jinhae District notice gives the kiosk location and lists electronic maps, land-use planning and imagery for integrated Changwon; in-person public access is described.
Official national K-GeoP page distinguishes personal land search requiring identity verification; no personal land lookup was used and it does not document a Changwon-specific public feature schema.
